scope.description: Parse, template expansion and complete checking of the same retained 52-file source closure; no emission.
scope.headline: Sum of source-processing phase wall times, excluding startup and process launch.

workload.sourceDeclarationsNote: Not independently counted in this check-only cohort; no historical declaration count is substituted.
workload.sourceTupleEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(sorted [relativePath, sha256, namespaceOrNull, externalBoolean] tuples); path order is Unicode code-point order.

runtime.nativeBuild: Cached historically validated -O1 split-LLVM artifact; not rebuilt.

methodology.inputValidation: Every source-universe file, selected input, kernel, runtime, compiler artifact, receipt, manifest and protocol helper rehashed before and after every sample and after the cohort. Bounded 64 KiB hashing occurs only in the unmeasured parent.
methodology.rssScope: 10 ms guardian sampling of the entire owned compiler-command process tree from launch through exit. Includes Node main and worker for official; native process for selfhostNative. Excludes the Bun launcher, guardian supervisor and cohort parent in both roles.
methodology.footprintScope: Same owned process tree and sampling interval; Darwin physical-footprint ledger, including compressed pages.
methodology.fullCommandScope: Guardian elapsedMs, including process startup, source processing and command teardown. Separate from source-processing phase sums.
methodology.cpuScope: Official CPU is process-wide Node CPU including helper threads; native CPU is RUSAGE_SELF across compute threads. Not equivalent to wall time.
methodology.ratio: Ratio of source-processing medians; no historical timing denominator.
methodology.guards: Sampled stop guards, not hard allocation quotas.

provenance.currentSourceAuthenticationLimitation: The historical native build no longer authenticates against current lexer/driver sources. That known wrapper failure was not rerun, patched or bypassed as a qualification claim. Execution uses the explicitly digest-bound raw native CLI.

reproducibility.prerequisites: Retained source corpus, pinned cached compiler and receipts, matching Node/Bun runtimes, and existing guardian helper. No rebuild is performed.

limitations: Single host and selected frozen compiler-source workload; not a universal performance proxy.
Check-only: not end-to-end compilation, code generation, C compilation, fixedpoint or fresh current-source build qualification.
Template expansion is interleaved differently; checker-only phase ratios are not comparable.
Three fresh processes per role; filesystem and OS caches were not flushed and no warmup samples were discarded.
Sampled process-tree peaks are not exact allocation peaks or end-of-phase heap sizes.
Fresh measurements do not replace separate historical self-hosting validation.
title: Self-hosted Bend compiler

limitations: The checked-program and backend-IR contracts are not a mechanized semantic-preservation proof.
The official TypeScript compiler already has checked terms and intermediate representations.
Shared lowering does not remove target-specific layout, analysis, runtime or foreign-code work.
Array-backed pools and numeric handles do not imply zero allocation or that all structures are flat.

validation.scope: Previously validated compiler snapshot; separate evidence from the fresh check-only comparison.
notEstablished: GPU, Metal, CUDA or WASM qualification
